surprises.head: Carolina hardly hit anyone
surprises.body: Carolina is one of the league’s heaviest-hitting teams. Not tonight: a hit score of 60 in the close stretches of the game, against their usual 128 (100 is league average, adjusted for the arena’s scorer). A team strays this far about once every 150 games. That’s rarer than once a season for any one team.

story.head: Gostisbehere wins it in overtime
paras: Pyotr Kochetkov was back in an NHL net for the first time since Dec 20, 2025, and got the win. Sebastian Aho got the scoring started for the Hurricanes just 10 seconds into the game, but Owen Tippett tied it 1-1 for Philadelphia midway through the first. Matvei Michkov gave the Flyers the lead midway through the second. Aho scored his second of the night on the power play early in the third to tie it 2-2. Shayne Gostisbehere won it on the power play just under three minutes into overtime. Aho added an assist for a three-point night.
The Hurricanes owned the chances, outshooting the Flyers 40-18, and still had to sweat it out in overtime. Joseph Woll made 37 saves in a losing effort for the Flyers.
The Hurricanes killed all four Flyers power plays. The Canes moved to 1-1-1, and the Flyers dropped to 0-1-2.
